Turtlemint Fintech IPO Marks Discounted Market Debut

Turtlemint's initial public offering (IPO) for its fintech solutions arm opened on June 29, with the shares listed at a discount. The IPO was subscribed 0.68 times, and the company aims to use the raised funds to grow its tech capabilities and brand presence. The listing price was ₹134.90 per share on NSE and ₹136 apiece on BSE, representing a 10.39% discount.
